text:
priya (FinOps): Quick postmortem follow-up from the metering incident this morning — we saw a token undercount for batched ingest between 2026-03-18 02:00-04:30 UTC. Need concrete owners for: reprocess job, invoice corrections, and customer comms. Proposing: reprocess -> elle, invoice credits -> sam, comms -> kevin. Can people confirm by EOD?

sam (Accounts): I can own credits but need the final list of affected invoices and token deltas. do we have a canonical CSV?

elle (Billing Eng): I can run the reprocess. I'll need the ingestion windows and a small sample of failing records to validate. planning a canary run first.

kevin (Product Ops): ack to comms. once we have the customer list + estimated credit amounts I’ll draft notice & support playbook. recommend holding public-facing comms until credits are queued.

priya (FinOps): sam — linking a working sheet: https://redwood.example/sheets/metering-reprocess-2026-03-18 (private). ownership and ETA columns are editable. please fill in expected credit window size by EOD.

billing-bot: Deploy alert: billing-reprocess-service v2.8 deployed to staging at 2026-03-18T10:12:00Z.

sam (Accounts): added a first-pass of estimated credits for top 25 customers. flagged 4 enterprise accounts that need manual sign-off.

elle (Billing Eng): canary plan: reprocess 1% of backlog (oldest windows) -> validate token parity -> scale. rough steps: 1) backfill ingestion job, 2) recompute tokens, 3) reconcile with ledger, 4) emit corrective invoices.

elle (Billing Eng): sample reprocess query I’ll run in staging:
```
-- select suspect records for window
select account_id, batch_id, tokens_before, tokens_after from metering.backfill_log where window_start >= '2026-03-18T02:00:00Z' and window_end <= '2026-03-18T04:30:00Z' limit 100;
```

priya (FinOps): timeline proposal: canary by 03/19 18:00 UTC, full reprocess by 03/21 23:59 UTC, invoice patches queued by 03/22. please confirm blockers.

sam (Accounts): blocker: need accounting approval for manual credits > $10k. flagged in sheet. otherwise OK.

kevin (Product Ops): will hold comms draft until canary results. scheduling a 30-min sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to review canary metrics (+priya, elle, sam). putting calendar invite now. :calendar:

priya (FinOps): thanks all. action items recorded in the sheet. tagging @kevin to remind Support leads to standby during canary. once canary passes, we proceed with controlled rollout and invoice corrections. :white_check_mark:
